rules.name: Aegis X”
rules.text: Friendly Units within X” of this Unit lose UC.

rules.name: Agile X
rules.text: During CQBs, this Unit automatically passes X DF rolls—each Unit in the Squad contributes X. It cannot automatically pass First Strike hits but gains +1DF against them. Agile Units gain +1DF against Collateral Damage hits.

rules.name: AWACS X”
rules.text: Enemy Aircraft within X” of this Unit may be attacked with a +1Ac bonus.

rules.name: Bloodthirsty
rules.text: While Occupying a Zone containing enemies, Bloodthirsty Infantry suffer -2 to Search rolls and may not exit.

rules.name: Breachers X
rules.text: Breachers may enter a Building from any point on it—they do not require an Entrance. Breachers ignore Sited enemies and the Automated Sentries and Seal Effect Features when entering Zones. When a Squad with Breachers enters a Building, select one random enemy Occupying Squad. Each Breaching Unit inflicts X Small Arms hits on that Squad.

rules.name: Climber
rules.text: This Unit may move over any scenery that isn’t Impassable Ground.

rules.name: Command Centre
rules.text: If this Unit contains a Commander, double the Radius of Command Cards measured from this Unit.

rules.name: Delayed
rules.text: This Transport cannot Disembark or Embark Units in the same Round that it Disembarks.

rules.name: Demo Charges X+
rules.text: If this Infantry Unit begins its activation inside a Zone, you may place a Demo Charge Token on that Zone. If enemy Occupiers are present, its Squad must pass a Bravery Test first. If you have no Occupiers in a Zone containing your Demo Charge Tokens, you may remove them all at the end of any friendly activation—each inflicts 2DP on that Zone on an X+. This suffers -1 if one enemy Occupying Squad is present, or -2 if more than one is present.

rules.name: Dogs
rules.text: Friendly Squads Occupying the same Zone as one or more friendly Dogs Units gain +1 to Search rolls. During step 3 of CQBs, players must allocate at least 1 hit to each enemy Squad with Dogs per remaining DP that Squad has before allocating any to other Squads. Dogs with Living Weapons may Embark into Transports.

rules.name: Ev X
rules.text: Weapons attacking targets with Ev suffer -X Ac. Ev is ignored when targeting friendly Units.

rules.name: Fast Mover
rules.text: Fast Movers are Aircraft with two Mv stats—a minimum and maximum. They must move at least their minimum Mv each activation, in a straight line, and before attacking. They may move less than their minimum Mv when entering the Table. They may pivot up to 45 degrees at the beginning of their move and again at its end. Units within a Fast Mover Squad must end their move parallel to each other, facing the same way. Fast Movers can always move off the Table. If any Unit in the Squad moves off, the Squad leaves the Table. They then return to Ready. Fast Movers ALWAYS begin the game Reserved. Fast Movers are ignored for determining Victory Points but do concede Kill Points. Commanders may not be assigned to Fast Movers.

rules.name: Flying High
rules.text: A Fast Mover Squad can elect to fly high at the end of its move, before pivoting– indicate this with a token. High-fliers can pivot up to 180 degrees. High-fliers can only target and be targeted by other Fast Movers flying high. Nothing blocks Line of Sight to high-fliers. A high-flier can end its move in illegitimate places, including over Zones— remove it from its flight stand/substitute if for a token if it can’t stand up. The Squad remains flying high until it leaves the Table or elects to return to normal height. It may do this at the end of its move, before pivoting.

rules.name: Flat Out X”
rules.text: If this Unit does not Embark, Disembark, or attack in an activation, it gains +X” Mv.

rules.name: FS X
rules.text: At the start of a CQB, each non-Sited Unit with First Strike inflicts X Small Arms hits on the enemy Squads, distributed freely. If both players have First Strike Units involved, the player without the Initiative distributes their hits first. DF saves are then attempted simultaneously.

rules.name: Hardy X
rules.text: Instead of using its DF, even if it would not normally be able to, this Infantry Unit may use a save of X+ against hits from Weapons, Collateral Damage, and Command Cards. Hits from anything above E2 ignore this rule.

rules.name: Infiltrate X”
rules.text: This Unit may always Deploy up to X” from their Territory. Infiltrating Infantry may Deploy as Occupiers in a Zone, but that Zone must be wholly within X” of their Territory. Transports of Squads with Infiltrate that choose to Infiltrate must begin Ready— they are allowed to start empty. Otherwise, Units cannot Infiltrate if part of a Group containing Units without Infiltrate. A Transport with Infiltrate confers Infiltrate to all Units aboard.

rules.name: Jump X”
rules.text: If it does not Embark or Disembark from a Unit that activation, this Unit may Jump when it starts moving—during its move, but not at its end, it is an Aircraft with an X” Mv. If Embarking/Disembarking from a Zone, this Mv is not halved. If an AA Weapon Reaction Attacks it, this Unit suffers -3A for that attack. Line of Sight is measured to a point 2” above the Jumper. Jump Infantry are still damaged as Infantry.

rules.name: Large
rules.text: Large Vehicles cannot be Obscured except by Obscured Status Tokens granted by Stealth—otherwise, if Obscured, you have Clear Line of Sight. If any part of a Large Vehicle miniature is within 2” of a Building when that Building is destroyed, it takes hits as if its centre was within 2”. When attacking with a Large Vehicle’s Weapons, use the Weapon’s pivot point (if it’s on a ball joint or turret) or the base of the barrel (if it’s fixed) to determine range and Line of Sight for that Weapon. Arcs should be drawn from the centre of the model as usual. When Embarking or Disembarking into or from a Large Transport, add 2” to the allowed Embark/Disembark distance. If the size of a Large Vehicle makes it impossible for a Weapon to get into range against it, physical contact is sufficient.

rules.name: Lethal
rules.text: CQB dice contributed by this Unit hit automatically.

rules.name: Living Weapons
rules.text: Commanders cannot be assigned to Living Weapons. They may begin the game aboard a Transport but may not Embark into one. They may enter Zones. Living Weapons cannot Search for or carry Objects. They cannot exit Zones with enemy Occupiers. A player with only Living Weapon Occupiers can only Contest that Zone. Living Weapons with the same name Occupying the same Zone automatically form one Squad/ join an existing Squad of Living Weapons with the same name at the start of the Initiation Phase—their player may choose which Squad they join. This can take the Squad above its maximum Squad size.

rules.name: Obscurer X”
rules.text: All friendly Vehicle and Infantry Units within X” of this Unit are Obscured to enemies.

rules.name: PX+
rules.text: This Unit may attempt to block any damage it would receive by rolling 1 D6 for each point of damage—each result of at least X blocks the damage. Against damage from E9 sources, after modifiers are applied, Passive Countermeasures suffer a -1 modifier. E10 sources, after modifiers are applied, ignore Passive Countermeasures. Once all modifiers are applied, Passive Countermeasures can never exceed 3+. Occupiers inside Zones with Passive Countermeasures gain those Passive Countermeasures against damage dealt directly by Weapons.

rules.name: Regenerate X
rules.text: This Unit recovers X lost DP in the Cleanup step of the End Phase.

rules.name: Resilient
rules.text: Criticals from non-Blast Weapon hits below E9, after modifiers are applied, do not inflict any additional damage against this Unit.

rules.name: Scanner
rules.text: This Unit gains Clear Line of Sight against targets that would otherwise be Obscured. Other Units in this Unit’s Squad, and other Units in its Group within 4”, also gain Clear Line of Sight against targets that would otherwise be Obscured.

rules.name: Scout
rules.text: You may measure a Command Card’s Radius from friendly Scout Units. If a Weapon with Indirect draws Line of Sight from this Unit, the -2Ac penalty is ignored.

rules.name: Shield: X Y” Z+
rules.text: All Units/Zones as defined by X within Y” of this Unit gain Z+ Passive Countermeasures.

rules.name: Skimmer
rules.text: Skimmers ignore all types of Ground and may move over protruding Ground details less than 1” high. Skimmers may drop down any incline.

rules.name: Rapid Insertion X”
rules.text: An Aircraft transporting Rapid Insertion Units which have not Embarked this Round may move up to an additional X” after all other modifiers are applied before these Units Disembark. The Aircraft cannot move further than its unmodified Mv using this rule. Units with Rapid Insertion may Disembark when their Transport is within 3” of an enemy Vehicle.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.text: If it will spend its full activation disembarked, this Squad may choose to only move OR move 0” and attack. If it does, this Squad gains an Obscured Status Token. Squads with Obscured Status Tokens are Obscured.

rules.name: Strike
rules.text: This Unit may always begin the game Ready. Units Disembarking directly from this Unit gain Assault on their Weapons.

rules.name: Strong
rules.text: Per Squad with two or more Strong Units in a CQB, one enemy Squad of your choosing suffers -1DF for that CQB, assigned at the start of step 1 of that CQB.

rules.name: Surveyor
rules.text: If one or more Vehicles with Surveyor are within 1” of a Zone with friendly Occupiers at the end of the Round, you may place one Mapping Token on that Zone. When Searching for an Objective, you may spend two Mapping Tokens on that Zone to find the Objective on a 2+. If you have no Vehicles with Surveyor within 1” of a Zone at the end of any activation (yours or your opponent’s), remove all your Mapping Tokens from it.

rules.name: Terror
rules.text: Enemies Occupying the same Zone as Terror Units suffer -1B and -1 to Search rolls.

rules.name: UC
rules.text: If a Weapon targeting this Unit has two R values, it may always use its first.

rules.name: Wide X”
rules.text: Units in this Squad must maintain a coherency of X” rather than the usual 3”.

rules.name: Concussion
rules.text: If a Unit is hit by this Weapon, place a Concussed Status Token on its Squad. Concussed Squads suffer -2Ac. Concussed Infantry also count as Sited in CQBs and do not contribute to Entrances Covered.

rules.name: Critical X
rules.text: This Weapon inflicts X additional DP for each Critical it inflicts against Units.

rules.name: Demo X
rules.text: This Weapon can inflict Critical damage against Zones. It also inflicts X additional DP for each success when rolling to inflict damage against Zones.

rules.name: Destroyer X+
rules.text: If this Weapon hits by rolling equal to or higher than X, it will automatically cause a Critical instead of rolling to damage. This counts as a successful roll to damage. This Weapon’s Ac cannot be modified below X.

rules.name: AA
rules.text: Only AA Weapons can target Aircraft normally. AA Weapons ignore Ev on non-Aircraft. AA Weapons may Reaction Attack—see main rules.

rules.name: AA-R
rules.text: This AA Weapon may only Reaction Attack but suffers no penalty for doing so.

rules.name: AA-S
rules.text: This AA Weapon may not Reaction Attack.

rules.name: ALT X
rules.text: Units may only attack with one Weapon with the same ALT number (X) each Round.

rules.name: Articulated
rules.text: Line of Sight may be measured from a point 1” above the model’s centre when attacking with this Weapon.

rules.name: Assault
rules.text: This weapon may attack on the same round as Disembarking and/or entering a Zone. If it does so it suffers -2Ac, or -1Ac if it has a R of CC. If a Unit with an Assault Weapon Disembarks then moves 0”, it counts as having moved 1” for attacking purposes.

rules.name: Battery X
rules.text: This Weapon gains X E for each other instance of this Weapon in coherency. Only one Battery Weapon with the same name may attack per Squad per Round. If one attacks, each other instance of that Weapon in coherency counts as having attacked.

rules.name: Blast
rules.text: This Weapon uses the Blast Template — a 5” diameter circle. First, place the template’s centre over the target’s

rules.name: Devastator X
rules.text: This Weapon inflicts X additional DP for each success when rolling to inflict damage against Units.

rules.name: Dissipate -X
rules.text: This Weapon may suffer -X E to double its R value/s. It may do this twice to quadruple its R.

rules.name: Drive-by
rules.text: This Weapon may measure range and Line of Sight from any point its Unit moved through that activation if it moved in a single straight line. It may pivot before moving.

rules.name: Field
rules.text: This Weapon does not target anything. Instead, each Zone, Vehicle, and Infantry Unit within its R are assigned attacks equal to its Att. If its R exceeds 6”, Units within half its R are assigned attacks equal to twice its Att. Since it does not target anything, Line of Sight is not needed and friendlies may be hit. Units within this Weapon’s Squad are not damaged by it and cannot receive Concussed, Jammed, or Suppressed Status Tokens from it. If this Weapon has AA, you may assign its attacks only to Aircraft instead of Zones, Vehicles, and Infantry. If this Weapon places Status Tokens, place one on every Squad within its R that could receive the Token. This counts as placing one of that Token.

rules.name: Flame
rules.text: This Weapon ignores the Ac penalty against Obscured targets, and it ignores Evasion. Infantry suffer -1DF against this Weapon. This Weapon may target Occupiers as if they were Sited anywhere on a Zone. If friendly Squads are present in this Zone, all misses from your Flame Weapons which targeted enemies in this Zone this activation hit one random friendly Squad in that Zone instead. Flame Weapons with Small Arms may also combine their attacks against Zones. This Weapon can inflict Critical damage against Zones. Flame Weapons gain +1 Demo against Areas.

rules.name: Focus X
rules.text: You may discard any number of successful hits from one or more instances of this Weapon to add X E to another remaining hit. For example, two identical E2 Cannons with Focus 1 and 4 attacks each score a total of 6 hits. Their player chooses to discard 4 of these hits to add 2 Energy to each of the remaining hits, resulting in two E4 hits.

rules.name: GB
rules.text: A Weapon with a R value of GB is a Gravity Bomb. It may target anything within 2” of any point its Unit moved over that Round. Line of Sight is checked from that point.

rules.name: Ignores Cover
rules.text: This Weapon ignores the Ac penalty for Obscured targets. Sited Infantry may not use their DF value to block hits from this Weapon.

rules.name: Incendiary X
rules.text: Each hit from this Weapon that inflicts 1 or more damage against a Building inflicts X additional Collateral Damage hits. Each hit that inflicts 1 or more damage against an Area inflicts 2x X additional Collateral Damage hits

rules.name: Indirect
rules.text: When attacking with this Weapon, any other friendly Unit may also be used to draw Line of Sight from, in which case it suffers -2Ac. If that friendly Unit has Scout, the -2Ac is ignored. For Sited Units with Indirect, no portion of a Building they Occupy can lie between the face they are Sited on and their target.

rules.name: Ineffective: X
rules.text: This Weapon cannot damage or affect things of the type X.

rules.name: Jammer
rules.text: If a Unit is hit by this Weapon, place a Jammed Status Token on its Squad. Weapons with two R values that attack a Jammed Squad may use their 1st value. Jammed Squads, and Units and Weapons within them, cannot be affected by their player’s Command Cards that take effect while the Squad is Jammed.

rules.name: LX
rules.text: This Weapon may only attack X times/ game.

rules.name: Needs Spotter
rules.text: This Weapon’s target must be in Clear or Obscured Line of Sight of a friendly Unit with Scout, or it suffers -2Ac.

rules.name: Overcharge X
rules.text: If its Unit moves 0” (before or after attacking), this Weapon gains +X E that activation.

rules.name: Overwatch
rules.text: This Weapon may Reaction Attack against Vehicles and suffers no penalty for doing so. It may only Reaction Attack.

rules.name: Pen X+
rules.text: When rolling to inflict damage against Units, this Weapon may always succeed on a roll of X+ regardless of E or A values. This cannot be modified. This can alter the roll required for a Critical—Pen 4+ would inflict a Critical on a 6+.

rules.name: Precision X
rules.text: If its Unit moves 0” (before or after attacking), this Weapon gains +X Ac that activation and if it has Destroyer, it also gains +X Destroyer.

rules.name: Repair X/Y
rules.text: This Weapon may only target Y, and Y may be a friendly Unit. For each hit by this Weapon, the target regains X lost DP.

rules.name: Seeker
rules.text: This Weapon may target Occupiers as if they were Sited anywhere on a Zone. This Weapon ignores the Ac penalty against Obscured targets if they Occupy the same Zone as friendly Occupiers.

rules.name: Self-Destruct
rules.text: This uses the same rules as a Field Weapon, except that the attacking Unit is destroyed, and Units within its Squad can be damaged by it. If a Unit with a Self-Destruct Weapon is destroyed while not Embarked, roll a D6. On a 4+, the Unit must immediately attack with the Weapon before being removed, even if it could not normally attack.

rules.name: Smoke
rules.text: If a Squad receives at least as many hits from Weapons with Smoke during a single activation as it has Units, place an Obscured Status Token on that Squad. Squads with Obscured Status Tokens are Obscured. This Weapon may target friendly Units and may target its own Unit.

rules.name: Strafe
rules.text: This Weapon may freely split its attacks against targets within 3” of at least one other Unit it targets. This must be a single chain of targets.

rules.name: Suppress
rules.text: If a Unit is hit by this Weapon, place a Suppressed Status Token on its Squad. Suppressed Squads may only move 0” if any Unit within it attacks. Suppressed Fast Movers may not attack.

rules.name: TX
rules.text: This Weapon reduces the target’s Ev by X to a minimum of 0. For example, T2 would reduce Ev3 to Ev1.

rules.name: Collector X
rules.text: This Unit may hold up to X RM Tokens (see other Bioficer special rules).

rules.name: Genitor X
rules.text: Bioficer Units with a hollow green square Transport Symbol (e.g. ) are Genitor Units. Genitor Units may begin the game with up to X Raw Materials (RM) tokens aboard them, and they may begin empty—X is shown within their Transport Symbol. When building your Army, RM tokens cost 5pts each and are assigned to those Genitor Units. Their points contribute to their Group’s total cost but do not contribute towards any category. In game, RM tokens are worth 0pts, so they do not contribute to KPs etc. Genitor Units may never have more than X RM tokens aboard—any above X are discarded. Genitor Units may not spend more than X RM tokens per activation (see Generated). RM Tokens may be passed between Genitor and Collector Units within 5” of each other during either Unit’s activation. Genitor Units cannot pass RM Tokens to Collectors. When Genitor Units could normally Disembark a Squad, they may Spawn a Squad of Generated Units. This new Squad must be within its Squad size limits. It Disembarks in the usual way and joins the Genitor Unit’s Group. Genitor Units may Spawn multiple Squads per Round. A Genitor Unit inside a Zone may Spawn Squads at the beginning of its activation. A Genitor Unit may not Spawn a Squad in the same Round as Embarking any Units.

rules.name: Generated X
rules.text: Units of the category Generated are Generated Units. These have a solid green square Transport Symbol with thier RM cost X shown within it (e.g. ). These cannot be taken when building your Army. Generated Units may be Spawned by Genitor Units during the game. A Generated Unit costs X RM tokens to Spawn—remove those from the Genitor Unit as they Disembark. This is done by Unit—two Genitors with 3RM tokens each could not Spawn a Unit which costs 6RM.

rules.name: Advanced Genitor/ Generated
rules.text: Generated Units with a gold border on their Transport Symbol (e.g. ) may only be Spawned by a Genitor Unit with a gold number in its Transport Symbol. Advanced Genitors may Spawn non-advanced Generated Units. Advanced Generated Units may Embark into any Genitor as normal.

rules.name: Grubsinger
rules.text: Grubs Occupying the same Zone as one or more Units with this rule gain +1OF and +1DF.

rules.name: Puppet
rules.text: If this Unit it not within control range of a friendly Puppeteer, its OF becomes 1, its DF becomes 6+, it’s Mv becomes 0”, and it may not attack—these cannot be modified. Any special rules it has, besides Living Weapons, UC, and Puppet, cease to take effect. A player with only Puppet Occupiers out of control range may only Contest that Zone. You may not intentionally move Puppet Units out of control range.

rules.name: Puppeteer X”
rules.text: This Unit controls friendly Puppet Units within X” of it, including Occupiers, and Occupiers in the same Zone. Any non-Infantry Unit containing a Bioficer Commander gains Puppeteer 9”.

rules.name: Decon
rules.text: Whenever an enemy Unit is destroyed in the same activation as being hit by a friendly Decon Weapon, you may place RM Tokens on 1 Genitor or Collector Unit within 15” of that Unit. If it had 1-2 initial DP, or was an Infantry Unit, place 2 tokens. Otherwise, place 4 tokens. At the end of step 8 of a CQB, if any of your involved Units had Decon Weapons at the start of this CQB, place 2 RM tokens per enemy Infantry Unit destroyed. You cannot do this more times than you had involved Units with Decon Weapons (e.g. if you had 2 Units with Decon Weapons involved, and 3 enemy Units were destroyed, you may place up to 4 tokens).

rules.name: Nanomachines
rules.text: This Weapon has the Indirect and Ineffective: Zones special rules. It cannot target Aircraft and cannot attack while Sited.

rules.name: Supercruise
rules.text: At the start of this Unit’s activation, you may declare it will Supercruise. If you do, all its Weapons and any enemy Weapons targeting it suffer -1Ac until the end of the Round.

rules.name: Bikes X
rules.text: When outside a Zone, this Infantry Unit is treated as a Vehicle with an A value of X, although Blast Weapons still inflict D6 hits against them. In addition, Bikes have Resilient. Small Arms Weapons always treat units with Bikes as Infantry, meaning they cannot combine attacks and inflict 1 DP per hit. Bikes units outside Zones may always roll their DF against Small Arms hits, even if not Obscured. They may still enter Zones. Bikes lose any Ev and Weapons while Occupying.

rules.name: Firing Ports
rules.text: If an Infantry Unit will not Embark/Disembark from this Transport in its activation, this Transport gains that Infantry Unit’s Weapons that activation, except those with a R of CC. Those Weapons’ MA become Full and they lose Assault. This is cumulative with multiple Infantry Units. Those Weapons suffer -1Ac if this Transport Disembarks or moves over 0” that activation.

rules.name: Flexible Capacity
rules.text: This Transport may be taken if at least half full.

rules.name: Ram
rules.text: You may only attack with this Weapon after moving and if its Unit may use its full move. If you attack with it, its Unit counts as moving its full Mv. Directly after the attack, this Weapon’s Unit loses 1DP on a 4+.

rules.name: Subterranean
rules.text: If your Army contains Subterranean Units, any of your Squads may start the game in Holding. Unarmed Subterranean Units do not count against your number of allowed Groups. Subterranean Units with a Transport Symbol are not taken with any Units aboard. When a Subterranean Squad enters from Ready, it may be placed on Good or Exceptional Ground anywhere on the Table. From then on, unarmed Subterranean Squads cannot be activated. Squads in Holding may Disembark from ANY Subterranean Unit/s providing their Transport Symbols match. Squads which Embark into Subterranean Units are placed into Holding. Any Objects carried by Units Embarking into it leave the Table. Any Units which Embark cannot re-enter the Table that Round or next Round. Squads may Embark or Disembark into or from a Subterranean Unit outside of that Subterranean Unit’s activation. All other Embarking/Disembarking rules and restrictions still apply. Additionally, Subterranean Units may not Embark/ Disembark more than their Symbol indicates per Round, but they may do both. For example, one with could Embark , then Disembark . Units may still Embark/Disembark into/from Subterranean Transports if enemy Vehicles are within 3” of them.

rules.name: Subterranean Small
rules.text: Only Vehicles with an initial DP of 1, and Infantry, can Embark or Disembark into or from this Unit.

rules.name: Subterranean Medium
rules.text: Only Vehicles with an initial DP of 1-2, and Infantry, can Embark or Disembark into or from this Unit.

rules.name: Cling
rules.text: One Squad with Cling may be chosen Embarked aboard any Aircraft without the Cling special rule, including non-Transports, with the same or more initial DP than this Squad’s combined DP—Transport Symbols are ignored. This Squad joins that Aircraft’s Group. Once Disembarked, it may not Embark into Transports.

rules.name: Plasma Generator X”
rules.text: Friendly Weapons with ‘plasma’ in their name gain +1E if they attack while within X” of this Unit. This is not cumulative with other Plasma Generators. Weapons on Fast Movers are not affected.

rules.name: Razorworm Pod
rules.text: This Weapon may only target Zones. For each DP it inflicts, place 1 Unit of Razorworms in that Zone. All Razorworms placed in a Zone by Razorworm Pods form one Squad at the end of their Group’s attacks, within that Group. These Razorworms count as having Embarked into that Zone and may do nothing further that Round except fight in a CQB.

rules.name: Spark
rules.text: Spark Weapons gain Ac 2+ against Aircraft but cannot damage Zones.

rules.name: Gate
rules.text: If your Army contains Gates, any of your Squads may start the game in Holding. Gates are always Transports but are not taken with any Units aboard. Gates do not count against your number of allowed Groups. For Direct Deployment, each Gate is treated as a Group. A Gate is never part of another Group, but any number of them which have not yet been activated that Round may be activated together with any non-Gate Group. They then complete that activation as if they were a Group. Gates can only be activated this way except during in the Orphaned Transport Activations step of the Activation Phase, where any un-activated Gates must activate together. Squads in Holding may Disembark from ANY Gate/s providing their Transport Symbols match. Squads which Embark into Gates are placed into Holding. Any Objects they are carrying are passed to the Gate, even if it’s an Aircraft. Squads may Embark or Disembark into or from a Gate outside of that Gate’s activation. All other Embarking/Disembarking rules and restrictions still apply. Additionally, Gates may not Embark/Disembark more than their Symbol indicates per Round, but they may do both. For example, a Gate with could Embark , then Disembark .

rules.name: Aux Gate
rules.text: These are always Auxiliary Transports. They use the same rules as Gates except they are taken as non-Gate Squads and must be activated normally—they cannot be activated together with another non-Gate Group. Other Squads can still Embark/Disembark from them outside of that Aux Gate’s activation. Aux Gates cannot attack in the same round as Embarking/Disembarking. Command Cards which target Gates cannot target these.

rules.name: Aircharge
rules.text: This Weapon uses the same rules as an AA-R Weapon. Additionally, a Unit may only be targeted by a Weapon with this rule once during its activation.

rules.name: Grav
rules.text: When targeting Vehicles, add the target’s initial DP to this Weapon’s E. For Vehicles of A4 or higher add 1 more, or for Vehicles of A7 or higher add 2 more. For Vehicles with Large, it gains +1 Devastator. This Weapon ignores Resilient on Vehicles. This Weapon always damages Zones on a 3+ and has a Demo value equal to its E.

rules.name: Particle
rules.text: This Weapon ignores Passive Countermeasures and Resilient.

rules.name: Skimcharger
rules.text: If a friendly Squad with Skimmer receives at least as many hits from Weapons with Skimcharger during a single Activation as it has Units, place a Skimcharged Status Token on its Squad. Skimcharged Squads gain Flat Out 5”, +5” MA on their Weapons, and may benefit from Flat Out even if they Attack (but not if they Embark or Disembark).

rules.name: Microgate
rules.text: This Unit, and Units in coherency with it, gain Regenerate 2. At the beginning of this Unit’s activation, if all Units in its Squad are in coherency, you may place its Squad into Holding—this is an Embark operation. Any Objects this Squad is carrying must be dropped or passed to another Unit first.

rules.name: Subservient
rules.text: Subservient Units gain +2B and +2OF when occupying a Zone containing a friendly Unit without Subservient. Subservient Units in a Squad which also contains Units without Subservient gain any special rules those Units have. Commanders cannot be assigned to Subservient Units.

rules.name: Warsuit
rules.text: Small Arms Weapons and Weapons of E2 or lower which target this Infantry Unit must use their 2nd range value.

rules.name: Drone Base X: Y
rules.text: During this Unit’s activation, it may launch one Squad of X Units of Y. Follow the usual Disembarking rules, treating this Unit as their Transport. Each launched Squad joins this Unit’s Group. This Unit may not launch if 2 Y Squads are already in its Group. If this Unit is destroyed, all Y Squads in its Group are destroyed.

rules.name: Guard
rules.text: This Squad gains +2DF in CQBs. In addition, per Squad with two or more Guard Units in a CQB, one friendly Squad of your choosing gains +2DF for that CQB, assigned at the start of step 1 of that CQB.

rules.name: Remote Drone
rules.text: This Squad may not be taken in your Army. During its activation, you may destroy this Squad instead of attacking with it.

rules.name: Taking Behemoths
rules.text: Behemoths have a Groups Equivalent stat instead of Squad Size. A Behemoth counts as that many Groups when building your Army and generating Pass tokens but counts as 1 Group for the ‘no Group may cost more than 1/4 of your total allowed pts’ rule. Commanders cannot be assigned to Behemoths. Behemoths have the special Type ‘Behemoth’. They are treated as Vehicles with Large unless another rule contradicts this.

rules.name: Casual Games and Behemoth Scenarios
rules.text: In casual games, players may agree to waive any of the Army building restrictions. Also, several special Behemoth Scenarios allow players to take Behemoths in your Army in other ways

rules.name: Exceptions
rules.text: Behemoths are so huge that several things cannot affect them: 1. Command Cards cannot target Behemoths. Cards which target ‘all’ of anything which include a Behemoth (e.g. all friendly Units) do not affect the Behemoth directly. 2. Command Abilities cannot target Behemoths. 3. Behemoths cannot receive Status tokens. 4. Behemoths cannot be Obscured, even by special rules. 5. Behemoths cannot carry Objects. 6. Friendly Shield and Repair special rules cannot affect Behemoths. 7. Passive Countermeasures on Behemoths are unmodified by E9 and E10 sources. 1.3 Power & Activating Behemoths Behemoths activate differently from normal Groups, and often multiple times per Round. What is possible is governed by their Power stat. Behemoths begin each Round with a number of Power tokens (PT) equal to their Power. When you may activate a normal Group, you may instead activate a Behemoth with PT remaining. It must then complete one Action from the Power Table: PT Cost Action Reposition Move up to half Mv Advance Move up to full Mv Fire Attack with 1 Weapon Volley Attack with 2 Weapons Charge Add 1 to this Behemoth's Power next Round Discharge None Use Gear Varies Use one Gear. See ‘Gear’ You may move each Behemoth up to twice per Round, up to its full Mv each time. Normal Mv limits for Embarking/Disembarking are ignored for Behemoths, but they may only Embark/Disembark Units on Reposition. You may use each Gear once per Round. Each Weapon may attack once per Round. Normal MA limits apply—the total distance from both allowed moves is used.

rules.name: Behemoth Entry
rules.text: Unless a Scenario specifies an entry requirement for Behemoths, players have two op­ tions. Players must simultaneously reveal which they will be using for each Behemoth before the game begins. 1.4.1.1 Move On Entry This Behemoth begins Reserved and must enter using an Advance Action. 1.4.1.2 Drop Harness Entry This Behemoth begins in Holding and may only enter via Drop Harness from Round 2. At the end of its activation, a friendly Unit that has not Embarked/Disembarked this Round and has Scout, Command Centre, or contains a Commander may designate a point within 12” of itself in Line of Sight. That point must be on open Ground and at least 3” from any Unit or Zone. Next, move that point D6-2” in a random direction. Place that Behemoth with its centre on that point (see ‘Moving and Placing Behemoths’). This counts as a move for the Behe­ moth and it has 2PT remaining that Round.

rules.name: Vs Ground
rules.text: Behemoths ignore Exceptional and Poor Ground. Impassable Ground only applies for the Behemoth’s centre. Follow the usual rules for moving over protruding details. Most won’t hamper a Be­ hemoth and should be ignored when placing one unless reasonable judgement says otherwise. Players may need to temporarily remove protruding details when placing Behemoths.

rules.name: Vs Areas
rules.text: Behemoths may move through and end their move overlapping Areas. Behemoths must use 2” of their available Mv for every 1” of Area their centre crosses. If any part of a Behemoth, but not its centre, moved through or overlaps an Area, that Area takes D3 damage and the Behemoth takes D3-2 E9 hits—use the same dice result for both. If a Behemoth’s centre moved through or overlaps an Area, that Area takes D6 damage and the Behemoth takes D6-4 E9 hits—use the same dice result for both. If necessary, substitute a 3D Area for a 2D one when placing Behemoths.

rules.name: Vs Buildings
rules.text: Behemoths may move through Buildings but may not end their move overlapping them. If a rule would force one to overlap with a Building, the Behemoth’s player must shift it so that they are in contact but not overlapping if there’s no alternative. Behemoths must use 3” of their available Mv for every 1” of Building their centre crosses. For Behemoths with a starting DP of 10 or fewer, their centres may not move through a Building. If any part of a Behemoth, but not its centre, moved through a Building, that Building takes D6 damage and the Behemoth takes D6-3 E9 hits—use the same dice result for both. If a Behemoth’s centre moved through a Building, or if any part of it was forced to overlap with one, roll 1D6 for each of that Building’s starting DP. Each 4+ inflicts 1 damage on that Building. Each 6 also inflicts an E9 hit on that Behemoth.

rules.name: Vs Units
rules.text: Behemoths may move through non-Behemoth Units. Each enemy Vehicle or Infantry Unit moved through takes D3-1 damage. Each time a 3 is rolled for a Vehicle with 3 or more starting DP, that Behemoth takes an E9 hit. Behemoths may end their move overlapping non-Behemoth Units. Aircraft must then be shifted the minimum possible distance by their player, maintaining coherency. Vehicles and Infantry are destroyed. For each Vehicle destroyed, roll 1D6 for each of its starting DP. Each 4+ inflicts an E9 hit on that Behemoth.

rules.name: Attacking Behemoths
rules.text: Areas are ignored when drawing Line of Sight to/from Behemoths. Otherwise, attacking Behemoths involves these additional rules:

rules.name: Concentrate Fire
rules.text: Weapon attacks of E5 or higher gain Focus 2 against Behemoths.

rules.name: Flanking Fire
rules.text: Behemoths suffer -1A if attacked by Weapons within the Behemoth’s rear arc. Use the same arcs the Behemoth would use to attack to determine if it is being targeted in the rear. Behemoths suffer -1A if attacked by non-CC Weapons within 6”. Both may apply for -2A.

rules.name: Huge Targets
rules.text: Weapons always hit Behemoths on a 2+. This cannot be modified, even by special rules, except by aiming for Systems Damage and Decoys. Weapons with an Ac value of A hit Behemoths automatically.

rules.name: Weapon Special Rule Modifiers
rules.text: These Weapon Special rules suffer modifiers against Behemoths: 1. Destroyer Weapons on non-Behemoths suffer -1 Destroyer. 2. Pen Weapons of E3 or lower suffer -1Pen after all other modifiers are applied. If applied to Pen 6+, Pen is ignored. 3. Grav Weapons gain only +5E and +1 Devastator against Behemoths.

rules.name: Damage Thresholds
rules.text: Behemoths have multiple DP values (e.g. 7,14, 20). The final value its actual DP. If it has not been damaged up to the first value, it is Intact. For Behemoths with 2 values, if it has been damaged up to the first value or higher, it is Crippled. For Behemoths with 3 values, if it has been damaged up to the first value or higher, it is Degraded. If it has been damaged up to the second value or higher, it is Crippled. Degraded Behemoths cannot use Advance. Crippled Behemoths cannot use Advance or Charge. They are worth half their pts for scenario and scoring purposes, including KP.

rules.name: Systems Damage
rules.text: If an enemy Behemoth begins a friendly activation Intact, you may roll one D3 against the Systems Damage Table at the end of that activation for every 3 damage it takes directly from non-CC Weapon attacks during that activation. Roll for each 3 damage and apply the effect before rolling again (e.g. if 6 damage was dealt). If it was Degraded at the beginning of that activation, roll 2D3 instead. If it was Crippled at the beginning of that activation, roll 3D3 instead. Result Effect ACM Offline 0-1 Weapons may use their 1st R value against this this Round. Power Fluctuations -1 PT. Cannot use Advance or Charge next Round. Cannot move again this Round. Can only move once next Drive Destabilised Round. Gear Destroyed Cannot use one random Gear (permanent). Drive Damaged Reposition and Advance cost +1PT (permanent). Cell Destroyed -1 PT. Suffers -1 Power (permanent). All Weapons suffer -1Ac. Cannot aim for Systems Damage Optics Damaged (permanent). Internal Explosion Takes D3 damage. One random non-Secondary Weapon* cannot attack Weapon Destroyed (permanent). Armour Cracked Suffers -1A (permanent). Core Rupture Remove all PT. Suffers -2PT and -1A (permanent). Heart Shot Behemoth destroyed. For results 6 and 9, if an already destroyed System/Weapon is chosen, apply results 5 and 8 instead, respectively. Otherwise, duplicate results are cumulative. * For this roll, Weapons with the same Alt value count as a single Weapon. 1.5.6.1 Aiming for Systems Damage Immediately before declaring targets when attacking, you may declare you are aiming for Systems Damage against one or more enemy Behemoths. For that activation, your non-CC Weapons suffer -1 to the roll required to hit that Behemoth. For that activation, you may modify any Systems Damage result against it by up to three, and you choose which System/Weapon is destroyed for results 6 and 9.

rules.name: Mortal Damage
rules.text: When a Behemoth is destroyed, it is not immediately removed. Instead, its player must roll 1D6 against the Mortal Damage table at the end of the current activation and apply the result before removing it. Add 1 to the result if that Behemoth had a starting DP of 15 or higher: Result Effect Slumped 1-2 Leave the miniature in place. It is still destroyed. That Behemoth may make a Fire or Volley Action if it has Blaze of Glory sufficient PT. Then, apply result 4. Units and Zones within 6" suffer an E6 hit. Place a Jammed Cell Burst Status Token on every Squad this damages. Non-Behemoth Vehicles and Infantry within D3+4" are Structural Collapse destroyed on a 5+ (roll for each). Behemoths and Zones within 6" take D6 E10 hits. Within 2D6", Units suffer an E10 hit, Infantry and Units with 1 Magazine Detonation starting DP are destroyed, and Zones suffer D6 damage. Place a Concussed Status Token on every Squad this damages. Core Implosion Units and Zones within D3+5" are destroyed.

rules.name: Transport Behemoths
rules.text: Some Behemoths are Transports. Except for Behemoths with the Director Gear, Behe­ moths taken with Squads aboard do not share a Group with their transported Squads. Instead, all Squads aboard a Behemoth at the start of the game form a single Group. They may Disembark during their own Activation or while their Behemoth makes a Reposi­ tion Action. A Behemoth’s Mv is not reduced if it Disembarks Units, but no Units may Disembark from a Behemoth during a Round in which it makes an Advance action. Units cannot Embark into Transport Behemoths other than Gate Behemoths. Any Units Embarked in a Behemoth when it is destroyed are destroyed.

rules.name: Gear
rules.text: Behemoths often incorporate non-Weapon equipment that expends PT to use (cost shown before each System’s name on the Behemoth’s stat sheet). These are:

rules.name: Director X: Y
rules.text: This Behemoth has a Transport capacity specifically for Squads with Directed. X states the number of those Squads and Y states the number of Units within them. The Behe­ moth is their Director, and they are Directed by it. A Behemoth with Director begins the game with its Transport capacity filled. When this Behemoth uses this Gear, it may Disembark one Squad of Directed Units. Directed Units are a part of this Behemoth’s Group but can only activate when it uses this Gear, at the end of that Action. Directed Units are destroyed when their Behemoth is destroyed. Otherwise, they act as normal Units.

rules.name: Jump System X”
rules.text: When it next moves, this Behemoth’s Mv becomes X” and it ignores all scenery and Units while moving. Placing it, though, follows the normal rules. Its next move Action costs 0PT (either Reposition or Advance).

rules.name: Decoys
rules.text: Enemy Weapons suffer -1 to the roll required to hit this Behemoth this Round. This System may only be used once per game and is ignored for Gear Destroyed results once used.

rules.name: Shield Booster
rules.text: This Gear cannot be used in a Use Gear Action. Instead, immediately before rolling Passive Countermeasure saves due to enemy attacks, you may spend any amount of PT. If you do, you may have two of the saves per PT spent negate the incoming damage on a 2+, after all other modifiers are applied. You may do this any number of times per Round. If you roll a 1 for any of these upgraded saves, this Gear is destroyed at the end of that enemy activation. If this Gear is destroyed, this Behemoth loses its Passive Countermeasures.

rules.name: Redundancy
rules.text: Remove one permanent Effect from Systems Damage on this Behemoth. Weapon De­ stroyed requires double this System’s PT cost to remove. This cannot be used to remove Weapon Destroyed from Integral Weapons. This System may only be used once per game and is ignored for Gear Destroyed results once used.

rules.name: Healing System X
rules.text: This Behemoth recovers X lost DP.

rules.name: Scrambler +X
rules.text: One Behemoth in Line of Sight suffers an additional -1 Ac penalty when Aiming for Sys­ tems Damage this Round. In addition, that Behemoth must spend +X PT to Use Gear this Round.

rules.name: Shroud X+
rules.text: On an X+, you opponent cannot aim for Systems Damage against this Behemoth until the start of its first Action next Round.

rules.name: Target Lock
rules.text: Pick an enemy Squad in Clear Line of Sight of this Behemoth. Weapons fired by this Behemoth in later Actions this Round gain +3Ac against that Squad and may ignore the accuracy reduction incurred by aiming for Systems Damage.

rules.name: Weapons Capacitors
rules.text: Weapons with Capacitors on this Behemoth gain the stated effect when attacking this Round. 2. Behemoth Special Rules

rules.name: Directed
rules.text: This Unit may not be taken in your Army—it is included with its Behemoth. This Unit cannot activate or Embark/Disembark except when its Behemoth’s Director Gear is used. It does not count towards your Groups when generating pass tokens. It can­ not carry Objects. If this Unit’s Behemoth is destroyed, this Unit is destroyed.

rules.name: Integrated Gate
rules.text: This Behemoth functions as an Auxiliary Gate, except that Squads can only Embark/ Disembark from it outside of its activation. In addition, this Behemoth may attack in the same Round as Embarking/Disembarking Units. A Gate Behemoth’s movement is not reduced if Units Embark into or Disembark from it, but no Units may Embark or Disembark from this Behemoth during a Round in which it makes an Advance action.

rules.name: Lithe
rules.text: This Behemoth’s centre counts as any other part of it when moving over or being placed on Zones.

rules.name: Walker X” x Y”
rules.text: Many Behemoths stride into battle and can move dynamically. On something this huge, its pose could excessively advantage/disadvantage it. Treat Walkers as if they were a solid cylinder with an X” radius and Y” high. When measuring to/from a Walker, use any point within this cylinder to determine range and Line of Sight (use the same point for both). Arcs should be drawn to/from the centre of the model as usual. Walkers must still conform to the normal placement rules too—parts of the model that protrude from this cylinder still count, but ONLY when placing. Be mindful of this when building them. An ultra-wide pose might make one needlessly awkward to place. 3. Behemoth Weapon Special Rules

rules.name: Capacitors: X
rules.text: This Weapon can gain one or more modifiers from a Weapons Capacitors System.

rules.name: Disrupt
rules.text: If this Weapon damages a Behemoth, you may make one D3 roll against that Behemoth on the Systems Damage table at the end of that activation. The result cannot be modified. Damage dealt by this Weapon still contributes to normal Systems Damage amounts, and this roll is in addition to any others.

rules.name: AS X
rules.text: If this Weapon damages a Behemoth, you may modify any Systems Damage roll against that Behemoth that activation by up to X.

rules.name: Huge Blast
rules.text: This is a Blast Weapon but instead uses an 8” diameter template.

rules.name: Integral
rules.text: This Weapon can receive 2 Weapon Destroyed results from Systems Damage, and it re­ quires 2 results before it cannot attack. It suffers -1E after one Weapon Destroyed result. This Weapon counts as 2 Weapons on the Actions table so can only attack using Volley.

rules.name: LT X”
rules.text: This Weapon cannot attack non-Behemoth Units within X”.

rules.name: Linked X
rules.text: Weapons with the same Linked number count as one Weapon for Actions and spending PT.

rules.name: Macro
rules.text: Macro Weapons have Strafe and may always use their 1st R value against non-Behe­ moths. They ignore Passive Countermeasures on non-Behemoths. Macro Weapons suffer -1Ac against Units with 2 or fewer starting DP. Against non-Behemoth Units, each hit inflicts 2DP without rolling to inflict damage. Since you do not roll to inflict damage, Criticals are not inflicted. However, if this Weapon has Devastator, it’s additional damage is still added—the automatic 2DP counts as one success. Infantry Units hit by Macro Weapons are destroyed. If hits would be assigned to the Squad instead of individual Units, one Unit in the Squad is destroyed per hit, starting with the most damaged. Damage dealt by Macro Weapons with CC does contribute to Systems Damage, but they do suffer the accuracy penalty when aiming for Systems Damage. If a Macro Weapon damaged a Behemoth on the same activation as it was destroyed, add 1 to the Mortal Damage result.

rules.name: Secondary
rules.text: This Weapon may attack at the end of any of its Behemoth’s Actions in addition to other Weapons that attacked that Action. 4. Behemoth FAQ’s & Rules Clashes

rules.name: Vs Shaltari ‘Confound’ Command Card
rules.text: Behemoths are still affected by this as the target is the opponent. If the roll in ‘Effect’ is failed when choosing to make an Action with a Behemoth, another Group must be cho­ sen if any remain available.
